about_the_game:
Battle

The key to victory is to move flexibly, dodge decisively, and grasp the best attack timing on the battlefield!

High degree of freedom in genre construction

You need to select the most suitable reward from the rewards that appear after defeating the enemy each time, and combine it to create a perfect structure that is unique to you;

Or blindly making choices may lead to unintended consequences.

Rich choices and diverse combinations

·There are a total of 17 types of soul stones: after obtaining them, they rotate around themselves and automatically attack when approaching enemies, with different mechanisms.

·There are a total of 19 magic arrays: After obtaining them, arrange them in order. Press and hold the skill key to launch consecutive multiple magic attacks.

There are endless unique gains waiting for you to discover!

Mastering the power of elements proficiently

Elemental attacks with 10 attributes, including explosion (fire+physics), snow blowing (ice+wind), conduction (water+thunder), and dispersal (dark+light),

An excellent combination of elements will unleash even greater power!

Unlock more professions

After reaching the unlocking conditions, more professions can be unlocked. After choosing a profession, there will be a chance to receive super rewards exclusive to the profession in the game!

Prompt

·Focus as much as possible on two element attributes that can complement each other, in order to potentially enjoy common attribute bonuses in the future

·The timing of skill deployment is crucial! Skills may unleash devastating attacks or suffer devastating attacks.

·Familiarizing oneself with the operation and mechanism of this game will be a lengthy process

·After opening the game, you can directly set the game language in the upper right corner of the screen. It is recommended to play the game in full screen 1920x1080, otherwise the UI may not display completely.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: This is a Roguelike game that tests your reaction ability and building strength. To survive until the end, all you can rely on is your gradually proficient operating skills and constantly improving game understanding! Defeat wave after wave of enemies until the strongest enemy appears before you!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
